public typealias Flagged = Bool

public enum Label: String, Codable {
    case work
    case personal
}

public enum Priority: Int, Codable {
    case _1 = 1
    case _2 = 2
    case _3 = 3
}

public enum Score: Double, Codable {
    case _1 = 1
    case _2_5 = 2.5
    case _3 = 3
}

public struct Ticket: Codable {
    public var flagged: Flagged?
    public var label: Label?
    public var priority: Priority
    public var relatedPriorities: [Priority]?
    public var score: Score?
    public var severity: TicketSeverity?

    enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {
        case flagged = "flagged"
        case label = "label"
        case priority = "priority"
        case relatedPriorities = "relatedPriorities"
        case score = "score"
        case severity = "severity"
    }
}

public enum TicketSeverity: Int, Codable {
    case _1 = 1
    case _2 = 2
    case _3 = 3
}
